advancement.singulo.anchor.description.translation: 建立一個小型世界線錨點

advancement.singulo.bose.description.translation: 製作 玻色凝聚態催化劑

advancement.singulo.manipulator.descript.translation: 製作一個引力子操縱器

advancement.singulo.projector.descriptio.source: Make a holo projector and use it on a controller
advancement.singulo.projector.descriptio.translation: 製作全息投影機並在控制器上使用它

advancement.singulo.reactor.description.translation: 形成 彭羅斯反應爐

advancement.singulo.records.description.translation: 破解每一份古老的記錄

advancement.singulo.root.description.source: Extract energy from mass. Open the handbook to begin
advancement.singulo.root.description.translation: 從質量中提取能量。打開手冊開始

advancement.singulo.thermo.description.source: Build a thermoelectric generator and put it between hot and cold
advancement.singulo.thermo.description.translation: 建造一個熱電發電機並將其置於熱和冷之間

advancement.singulo.wormhole.description.source: Connect a pair of wormhole mouths

block.singulo.degenerate_compactor_vent.translation: 簡併壓實機冷卻通風口

block.singulo.shield_tower_crown.translation: 盾塔 發射器 皇冠

block.singulo.tipler_holder.translation: T 型筒時間晶體支架

compass.singulo.hint.source: Sneak-use on the cache of a cleared %s to tune it for the next ruin
compass.singulo.hint.translation: 潛行右鍵已攻略的%s的廢墟緩存，即可調校以搜尋下一處廢墟

compass.singulo.not_cleared.source: Clear %s first by opening its cache
compass.singulo.not_cleared.translation: 請先打開%s的廢墟緩存完成攻略

compass.singulo.upgraded.source: Compass tuned: it can now find %s
compass.singulo.upgraded.translation: 羅盤已調校：現在也能搜尋%s

death.attack.singulo.tidal.source: %1$s was torn apart by tidal forces

desc.singulo.accelerator_controller.source: Controls a square ring 8–32 wide. Bigger rings are faster and yield more monopoles.
desc.singulo.accelerator_controller.translation: 控制 8-32 寬的方形環。環越大，速度越快，產生的單極子越多。

desc.singulo.accelerator_tube.source: Tube segment of the Particle Accelerator ring.
desc.singulo.accelerator_tube.translation: 粒子加速器 環的管段。

desc.singulo.archive_terminal.source: Copies ruin records onto data cards, restores degraded parts and decodes crystal memories.
desc.singulo.archive_terminal.translation: 將廢墟記錄抄寫到資料卡上，修復劣化的零件，並讀取水晶記憶體。

desc.singulo.artificial_star_core.source: A star core that replaces nether stars.
desc.singulo.artificial_star_core.translation: 取代下界恆星的恆星核心。

desc.singulo.basic_circuit.source: The brain of every early machine.

desc.singulo.basic_frame.source: The frame almost every machine is built on.
desc.singulo.basic_frame.translation: 幾乎每台機器都建立在這個框架上。

desc.singulo.bh_container.source: A vessel for holding a tiny black hole.

desc.singulo.black_hole_bomb.source: Thrown: opens a tiny black hole that swallows its surroundings.
desc.singulo.black_hole_bomb.translation: 拋出：打開一個吞噬周圍環境的小黑洞。

desc.singulo.black_reinforced_glass.source: See-through, as hard and blast-resistant as the Black Reinforced Panel. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_glass.translation: 可透視，與黑色強化面板一樣堅硬且耐爆炸。需要鐵鎬或更好的鎬。

desc.singulo.black_reinforced_panel.source: A black panel as blast-resistant as obsidian. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.black_reinforced_panel.translation: 與黑曜石一樣耐爆炸的黑色面板。需要鐵鎬或更好的鎬。

desc.singulo.black_star_glass.source: Black Reinforced Glass with a four-pointed star.
desc.singulo.black_star_glass.translation: 帶有四芒星圖案的黑色強化玻璃。

desc.singulo.blank_data_card.source: An empty card for copying records in the Archive Terminal.
desc.singulo.blank_data_card.translation: 用於複製 檔案終端 中記錄的空卡。

desc.singulo.builder_wand.source: Creative only. Instantly builds the multiblock of a controller. Sneak to change size.
desc.singulo.builder_wand.translation: 僅限創意。立即建立控制器的多塊。潛行改變尺寸。

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity.source: Creates negative energy between mirrors to make exotic matter.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity.translation: 在鏡子之間產生負能量以製造奇異物質。

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_controller.source: Middle of the front, second layer, of the 5×5×5 cavity.

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_frame.source: Frame along the cavity edges (not the corners).
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_frame.translation: 沿著腔體邊緣（而不是角落）進行框架。

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_pump.source: Vacuum pumps on the eight corners.

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_shield.source: Magnetic shields either side of each window.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_shield.translation: 每個窗口兩側都有磁屏蔽。

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_wall.source: Vessel wall; any can be swapped for an I/O port.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_wall.translation: 容器壁；任何一個都可以替換為 I/O 連接埠。

desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_window.source: Middle of each side; shows the vacuum between the mirrors.
desc.singulo.casimir_cavity_window.translation: 每邊的中間；顯示鏡子之間的真空。

desc.singulo.catalyst_stabilizer.source: Use with a catalyst in your other hand to double its remaining life. Once per catalyst.
desc.singulo.catalyst_stabilizer.translation: 另一隻手持催化劑時使用，可使其剩餘壽命翻倍。每個催化劑僅限一次。

desc.singulo.catalytic_reactor.source: Makes catalysts, starting with the muon catalyst.
desc.singulo.catalytic_reactor.translation: 從μ子催化劑開始製造催化劑。

desc.singulo.ceramic_substrate.source: A fired ceramic board for circuits.
desc.singulo.ceramic_substrate.translation: 用於電路的燒製陶瓷板。

desc.singulo.cold_atoms.source: Atoms cooled close to absolute zero.
desc.singulo.cold_atoms.translation: 原子冷卻到接近絕對零度。

desc.singulo.compressed_block_1.source: Nine units of mass pressed together. The start of the compression chain.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_1.translation: 九個單位的質量壓在一起。壓縮鏈的開始。

desc.singulo.compressed_block_2.source: Nine Lv1 blocks (eight if mixed). Fuel for the Degenerate Furnace.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_2.translation: 九個 Lv1 區塊（如果混合則為八個）。 簡併熱爐 的燃料。

desc.singulo.compressed_block_2_mixed.source: Lv1 made from 3+ kinds of blocks needs only 8 for Lv2.
desc.singulo.compressed_block_2_mixed.translation: Lv1由3種以上的區塊組成，Lv2只需要8個。

desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_1.source: A compressed block made only of metals.
desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_1.translation: 僅由金屬製成的壓縮塊。

desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_2.source: Denser metal block, used for artificial star cores.
desc.singulo.compressed_metal_block_2.translation: 較緻密的金屬塊，用於人造星核。

desc.singulo.compressor.source: Presses plates. In mass mode it turns any item into mass for compressed blocks and pellets.
desc.singulo.compressor.translation: 壓制板材。在質量模式下，它將任何物品轉化為壓縮塊和顆粒的質量。

desc.singulo.confinement_ring.source: A ring that cages black holes and singularities in a magnetic field, its meteoric-iron core gathering the flux.
desc.singulo.confinement_ring.translation: 用磁場牢籠困住黑洞和奇點的環。隕鐵芯負責匯聚磁通。

desc.singulo.control_unit.source: A restored ancient control unit with limited uses.
desc.singulo.control_unit.translation: 一個經過修復的古老控制單元，用途有限。

desc.singulo.coolant_cartridge.source: A steel canister holding 100 mB of liquid nitrogen. Lets the Precision Assembler build cryogenic parts such as quantum computing modules.
desc.singulo.coolant_cartridge.translation: 裝有 100 mB 液氮的鋼罐。讓無法放入液體的精密組裝台也能組裝量子運算模組等低溫零件。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_casing.source: Cooling Tower wall. Panels on the 5×5 rings can be swapped for I/O ports.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_casing.translation: 冷卻水塔牆。 5×5 環上的面板可以更換為 I/O 連接埠。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_controller.source: Goes in the middle of the front, second layer. The tower is 7–15 high; taller is faster.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_controller.translation: 位於前部中間，第二層。塔高7-15層；越高越快。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_coolant_band.source: Coolant bands around the waist, every third layer.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_coolant_band.translation: 冷卻劑帶繞在腰部，每隔第三層。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_extension.source: Build the tower 10+ high to liquefy helium.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_extension.translation: 建造 10+ 高的塔來液化氦氣。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_glass.source: Window in the tower waist; the cores glow blue inside.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_glass.translation: 塔腰處開窗；核心內部發出藍光。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_grate.source: Grate closing the top; the vapour escapes through it.
desc.singulo.cooling_tower_grate.translation: 爐排封閉頂部；蒸氣經由它逸出。

desc.singulo.cooling_tower_rim.source: The 5×5 rim at the top of the tower.

desc.singulo.copper_wire.source: Tier 1 power cable. Loses a little energy over distance.
desc.singulo.copper_wire.translation: 1 級電源線。隨著距離的增加會損失一點能量。

desc.singulo.core_controller.source: Placed 5 below the core centre. Ignite the reactor from its screen.
desc.singulo.core_controller.translation: 放置在核心中心下方 5 處。從螢幕上點燃反應爐。

desc.singulo.cosmic_muon_collector.source: Collects cosmic-ray muons for free high up under open sky.
desc.singulo.cosmic_muon_collector.translation: 在開闊的天空下免費收集宇宙射線μ介子。

desc.singulo.creative_catalyst.source: Creative only. A catalyst that never wears out. Right-click to change its tier.
desc.singulo.creative_catalyst.translation: 僅限創意。永不磨損的催化劑。右鍵點選可變更其圖層。

desc.singulo.creative_energy_source.source: Creative only. Endless power pushed into every neighbour.
desc.singulo.creative_energy_source.translation: 僅限創意。無窮無盡的力量湧向每一個鄰居。

desc.singulo.cryogenic_cooling_tower.translation: 液化氮氣（以及高度 10+ 的氦氣）。

desc.singulo.cryogenic_turbine.translation: 透過蒸發冷媒產生電力。

desc.singulo.culture_data.source: A record from the culture facility.

desc.singulo.data_card_observation_log.source: A copy of an observation log, usable in recipes.
desc.singulo.data_card_observation_log.translation: 觀察日誌的副本，可用於食譜。

desc.singulo.data_card_quantum_fragment.source: A copy of a quantum data fragment.

desc.singulo.decoded_record.source: Right-click to read it and add the next ancient record to your handbook.
desc.singulo.decoded_record.translation: 右鍵單擊即可閱讀它，並將下一個古代記錄添加到您的手冊中。

desc.singulo.deep_sea_collector.source: On the sea floor, water pressure presses minerals into Pressure Crystals. Works from 16 blocks deep; fastest at 48 (one a minute). No power needed.
desc.singulo.deep_sea_collector.translation: 放在海底時，上方的水壓會把礦物壓成高壓晶體。水深 16 格以上運轉，48 格時最快（每分鐘 1 個）。不需要電力。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor.source: Crushes matter into degenerate shells and reactor parts.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor.translation: 將物質壓碎成簡併的外殼和反應器部件。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_contro.source: Middle of the front, second layer, of the 5×5×5 press.

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_frame.source: Frame along the 12 edges of the press.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_frame.translation: 沿著壓機的 12 條邊緣畫框。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_plate.source: Plating; any plate can be swapped for an I/O port.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_plate.translation: 電鍍;任何板均可更換為 I/O 端口。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_ram.source: Top centre; hammers down onto the anvil.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_ram.translation: 頂部中心；錘子落到鐵砧上。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_vent.source: Cooling vents along the top row of each side.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_vent.translation: 每側頂排都有冷卻通風口。

desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_window.source: Middle of each side; watch the ram strike.
desc.singulo.degenerate_compactor_window.translation: 每邊的中間；觀看公羊的撞擊。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace.source: A large generator burning Lv2 blocks.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace.translation: 燃燒 Lv2 塊的大型發電機。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_controll.source: Goes in the middle of a side, second layer from the bottom.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_controll.translation: 位於一側的中間，從底部算起的第二層。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_fin.source: Radiators on either side of each furnace window.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_fin.translation: 每個爐窗兩側都有散熱器。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_frame.source: The heavy frame along the 12 edges of the 5×5×7 furnace.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_frame.translation: 沿著 5×5×7 熔爐的 12 個邊緣的重型框架。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_piston.source: Sits in the middle of the top and bottom faces and crushes the fuel.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_piston.translation: 位於頂面和底面的中間並壓碎燃料。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_shell.source: Furnace plating. Any panel can be swapped for a Multiblock I/O Port.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_shell.translation: 爐鍍。任何面板都可以更換為 多方塊輸入輸出埠。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_tube.source: Copper pipes standing in the four inner corners of the furnace.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_tube.translation: 銅管豎立在爐子的四個內角。

desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_window.source: The middle column of each furnace side; shows the glowing core.
desc.singulo.degenerate_furnace_window.translation: 各爐邊中間立柱；顯示發光的核心。

desc.singulo.degenerate_nucleus.source: The uncollapsed gravity knot left at the heart of the Gravity Remnant. Used for the Singularity Encapsulator, Singularity Seed and Graviton Manipulator.
desc.singulo.degenerate_nucleus.translation: 重力殘渣核心中殘留的、未完全坍縮的重力團塊。用於奇點封裝器、奇點種子與重力子操控器。

desc.singulo.degenerate_precursor.source: Compressed blocks pressed to the edge of degeneracy around a pressure-crystal seed. Shells need less rock with it.
desc.singulo.degenerate_precursor.translation: 以高壓晶體為種，把壓縮方塊 Lv2 壓到接近簡併的狀態。用於簡併物質殼時可以減少岩石用量。

desc.singulo.degraded_anomaly_sample.source: A sample from the final lab.
desc.singulo.degraded_anomaly_sample.translation: 來自最終實驗室的樣本。

desc.singulo.degraded_cold_atom_trap.source: Restore it in the Laser Cooler.
desc.singulo.degraded_cold_atom_trap.translation: 將其恢復到 雷射冷卻器 中。

desc.singulo.degraded_control_unit.source: A degraded part. Restore it in the Archive Terminal.
desc.singulo.degraded_control_unit.translation: 退化的部分。將其恢復到 檔案終端 中。

desc.singulo.degraded_time_crystal_seed.source: Restore it to grow time crystals.
desc.singulo.degraded_time_crystal_seed.translation: 恢復它以生長時間晶體。

desc.singulo.dimensional_pocket.source: Right-click to open your own 27-slot storage from anywhere. The contents survive death.
desc.singulo.dimensional_pocket.translation: 右鍵即可隨時隨地打開專屬的 27 格收納空間。死亡後內容也不會消失。

desc.singulo.dormant_singularity_seed.source: Guarded by the Horizon Warden. Awaken it in the encapsulator.
desc.singulo.dormant_singularity_seed.translation: 由 視界守衛 守護。在封裝器中將其喚醒。

desc.singulo.echo_projector.source: Projects the Echo Sentinel. The more projectors remain, the less damage the sentinel takes. Breaks by hand.
desc.singulo.echo_projector.translation: 投射出回聲守衛身影的底座。剩下的投影器越多，守衛受到的傷害越少。徒手也能破壞。

desc.singulo.echo_resonator.source: Copies echo shards using a template shard.
desc.singulo.echo_resonator.translation: 使用模板分片複製回顯分片。

desc.singulo.electrolyzer.source: Splits water into hydrogen and oxygen.
desc.singulo.electrolyzer.translation: 將水分解成氫氣和氧氣。

desc.singulo.entangled_element.source: Always made in pairs. Used in detectors and links.
desc.singulo.entangled_element.translation: 總是成對製作。用於探測器和鏈路。

desc.singulo.ergosphere_ring.source: Extracts exotic matter from a fast-spinning core.
desc.singulo.ergosphere_ring.translation: 從快速旋轉的核心中提取奇異物質。

desc.singulo.event_horizon_shield.source: Protects a 32-block radius from explosions, griefing and hostile spawns.
desc.singulo.event_horizon_shield.translation: 保護 32 格半徑範圍內免受爆炸、破壞和敵對生成的影響。

desc.singulo.exotic_matter.source: Matter with negative energy density. Fuels gravity tech.
desc.singulo.exotic_matter.translation: 具有負能量密度的物質。為重力技術提供燃料。

desc.singulo.explorer_compass.source: Right-click to point at the nearest ruin of the chosen kind. Sneak-use to change the kind.
desc.singulo.explorer_compass.translation: 右鍵單擊以指向所選類型的最近的廢墟。偷偷使用來改變種類。

desc.singulo.extraction_port.source: Power/fuel port for the reactor. Replaces any ring shell block (not the gyro drives).
desc.singulo.extraction_port.translation: 反應器的電源/燃料端口。替換任何環殼塊（不是陀螺儀驅動器）。

desc.singulo.focusing_magnet.source: Magnet for the ring corners and at least 1/4 of the ring.
desc.singulo.focusing_magnet.translation: 磁鐵用於環角和環的至少 1/4。

desc.singulo.fulgurite.source: Natural high-purity quartz glass fused by lightning. Used to make optical lattice substrates.
desc.singulo.fulgurite.translation: 被閃電熔化後凝固的高純度天然石英玻璃。用於製作光晶格基板。

desc.singulo.fulgurite_block.source: Sand fused by a lightning strike. Break it for fulgurite.
desc.singulo.fulgurite_block.translation: 被閃電擊中瞬間熔化凝固的沙子。破壞後掉落閃電熔岩。

desc.singulo.gravitational_containment_t.source: The only tank that holds dark matter. Keeps its contents when broken.
desc.singulo.gravitational_containment_t.translation: 唯一容納暗物質的容器。破損時保留其內容。

desc.singulo.gravitational_wave_detector.source: Points toward the nearest gravitational anomaly.

desc.singulo.graviton_manipulator.source: The full gravity tool. Hold left-click to use; while levitating, charge with right-click and release to throw.
desc.singulo.graviton_manipulator.translation: 全重力工具。按住左鍵即可使用；懸浮時，右鍵點選蓄力，放開即可投擲。

desc.singulo.gravity_boots.source: No fall damage. Jump while touching a wall in mid-air to kick off it (three times before landing).
desc.singulo.gravity_boots.translation: 免疫摔落傷害。在空中貼著牆跳躍即可蹬牆再跳（落地前最多三次）。

desc.singulo.gravity_field_stabilizer.source: A component of the core controller.
desc.singulo.gravity_field_stabilizer.translation: 核心控制器的組成部分。

desc.singulo.gravity_panel_receiver.source: Powers every gravity panel connected to it. When power runs short, only the nearest panels it can pay for work. Right-click to see how many are active.
desc.singulo.gravity_panel_receiver.translation: 為與其相連的所有重力面板供電。電力不足時，只有它能負擔的最近的面板會運作。右鍵查看正在運作的數量。

desc.singulo.guardian_core.source: The seal in the floor of a ruin boss room. It wakes the ruin's guardian when a challenger enters. Unbreakable.
desc.singulo.guardian_core.translation: 埋在廢墟首領房間地板中的封印。挑戰者進入房間時，會喚醒該廢墟的守衛。無法破壞。

desc.singulo.gyro_drive.source: Placed where the reactor rings cross.
desc.singulo.gyro_drive.translation: 放置在反應爐環交叉的地方。

desc.singulo.halo_collector.source: Gathers dark matter near a running core.
desc.singulo.halo_collector.translation: 在運作的核心附近聚集暗物質。

desc.singulo.handbook.source: Right-click to open. Explains goals, machines, multiblocks and shows your progress.
desc.singulo.handbook.translation: 右鍵單擊開啟。解釋目標、機器、多塊並顯示您的進度。

desc.singulo.hawking_collector.translation: 在催化劑模式下收集 霍金凝聚體。

desc.singulo.heat_exchange_core.source: Heat exchangers stacked up the middle of the tower.
desc.singulo.heat_exchange_core.translation: 熱交換器堆放在塔的中間。

desc.singulo.high_gravity_panel.source: When powered, standing on it raises your gravity 2.5x until you next land. Joins visually with its neighbours.
desc.singulo.high_gravity_panel.translation: 通電時，站在上面會使你的重力變為 2.5 倍，直到下次著地。外觀會與相鄰的面板相連。

desc.singulo.holo_projector.source: Use on a multiblock controller to project its shape and list missing blocks. Sneak-use to change size.
desc.singulo.holo_projector.translation: 在多塊控制器上使用來投影其形狀並列出缺少的塊。偷偷使用來改變尺寸。

desc.singulo.horizon_bus.source: The tier 5 cable, needed to ignite the reactor.
desc.singulo.horizon_bus.translation: 點燃反應器所需的 5 級電纜。

desc.singulo.impact_generator_panel.source: Landing on it causes no fall damage. Stores 1,000 FE per block fallen (up to 20,000 FE) and powers connected gravity panels.
desc.singulo.impact_generator_panel.translation: 落在上面不會受到摔落傷害。每下落 1 格儲存 1,000 FE（最多 20,000 FE），並為相連的重力面板供電。

desc.singulo.inertial_control_gauntlet.source: Hold right-click to levitate or pull one small mob. Sneak-use to switch modes.
desc.singulo.inertial_control_gauntlet.translation: 按住右鍵可懸浮或拉動一個小生物。潛行使用來切換模式。

desc.singulo.inertial_stabilizer.source: Stops explosions from breaking blocks within 16 blocks.
desc.singulo.inertial_stabilizer.translation: 阻止 16 塊內的塊被破壞而發生爆炸。

desc.singulo.intact_ruin_glass.source: An intact ancient window, as tough and blast-resistant as a ruin panel.
desc.singulo.intact_ruin_glass.translation: 完好保存的古代窗戶，與廢墟面板一樣堅固且耐爆炸。

desc.singulo.jet_collector.source: Collects jet condensate from the reactor.
desc.singulo.jet_collector.translation: 收集反應器中的噴射冷凝物。

desc.singulo.jet_condensate.translation: 來自相對論性噴流的粒子。

desc.singulo.keraunos_tower.source: Builds up 1,000,000 FE and hurls artificial lightning at the nearest lightning rod within 16 blocks. Sand under the rod turns into fulgurite. Three firing modes: manual, redstone and auto (sneak-right-click to switch).
desc.singulo.keraunos_tower.translation: 蓄積 1,000,000 FE 後製造人工閃電，射向 16 格內最近的避雷針。避雷針下方的沙子會變成閃電熔岩塊。有手動、紅石、自動三種發射模式（潛行右鍵切換）。

desc.singulo.kiln.source: Fires ceramics and boards. Oxygen makes it hotter.
desc.singulo.kiln.translation: 燒製陶瓷和木板。 氧 讓它變得更熱。

desc.singulo.laser_cooler.source: Laser-cools atoms into cold atoms, lattices and condensates.
desc.singulo.laser_cooler.translation: 雷射將原子冷卻成冷原子、晶格和凝聚體。

desc.singulo.low_gravity_panel.source: When powered, standing on it cuts your gravity to a fifth until you next land (less fall damage too). Joins visually with its neighbours.
desc.singulo.low_gravity_panel.translation: 通電時，站在上面會使你的重力降為五分之一，直到下次著地（摔落傷害也會減少）。外觀會與相鄰的面板相連。

desc.singulo.magnetic_bottle.source: Captures strangelets and contains leaking strange matter.
desc.singulo.magnetic_bottle.translation: 捕獲奇異子並包含洩漏的奇異物質。

desc.singulo.magnetic_key.source: Opens or seals a magnetic-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.magnetic_key.translation: 用於打開或封印磁力鎖容器。每次使用都會消耗。

desc.singulo.magnetic_monopole.source: A theoretical particle born in about 1 of 1000 collisions.
desc.singulo.magnetic_monopole.translation: 理論粒子在 1000 次碰撞中大約有 1 次誕生。

desc.singulo.mass_pellet.source: Packed mass fuel for the P-Reactor.
desc.singulo.mass_pellet.translation: 彭羅斯反應爐 的包裝品質燃料。

desc.singulo.meteoric_iron_chunk.source: Natural iron-nickel alloy inside a meteorite. Mine it (iron pickaxe or better) for raw meteoric iron. Found only in meteor craters.
desc.singulo.meteoric_iron_chunk.translation: 隕石中的鐵鎳天然合金。用鐵鎬或更好的鎬開採可得到粗隕鐵。只在隕石坑中出現。

desc.singulo.meteoric_iron_ingot.source: A strongly magnetic natural iron-nickel alloy, used for magnet pole pieces, magnetic keys and confinement rings.
desc.singulo.meteoric_iron_ingot.translation: 具有強磁性的鐵鎳天然合金。用於磁鐵的磁極片、磁鎖鑰匙和磁約束環。

desc.singulo.meteorite_crust.source: The burnt, melted shell of a crater meteorite. Only shells still in their crater slowly grow stardust clusters.
desc.singulo.meteorite_crust.translation: 包裹隕石坑中心隕石的、被燒熔的黑色外殼。只有原本就在隕石坑裡的熔殼會慢慢長出星塵晶簇。

desc.singulo.metric_drive.source: Switch between low gravity, flight and high gravity.
desc.singulo.metric_drive.translation: 在低重力、飛行和高重力之間切換。

desc.singulo.micro_black_hole.source: Holds a tiny black hole. Bends light around it.
desc.singulo.micro_black_hole.translation: 擁有一個微小的黑洞。使周圍的光線彎曲。

desc.singulo.mirror_plate.source: Inner 3×3 of the cavity top and bottom: two facing mirrors.
desc.singulo.mirror_plate.translation: 腔體頂部和底部的內部3×3：兩個面向鏡子。

desc.singulo.monopole_upgrade.source: Insert into a machine's monopole slot: ×2 speed and 50% better power efficiency.
desc.singulo.monopole_upgrade.translation: 插入機器的單極插槽：速度提高 2 倍，電源效率提高 50%。

desc.singulo.multiblock_port.source: Replaces a plain shell panel of a multiblock (not frames or functional parts; for the accelerator, either side of the controller). Cables and pipes reach the controller, and outputs and generated power are pushed out automatically.
desc.singulo.multiblock_port.translation: 替換多塊的普通外殼面板（不是框架或功能部件；對於加速器，控制器的任一側）。電纜和管道到達控制器，輸出和發電自動推出。

desc.singulo.muon_bundle.source: A bundle of muons, the base of muon catalysts.
desc.singulo.muon_bundle.translation: 一束μ子，μ子催化劑的基礎。

desc.singulo.muon_catalyst.source: Tier 2 catalyst with a lifetime. Leaves a spent catalyst when used up.
desc.singulo.muon_catalyst.translation: 具有使用壽命的 Tier 2 觸媒。用完後留下廢棄催化劑。

desc.singulo.neutrino_observatory.source: Keeps scanning a wide area and shows ores and ruins to nearby players. Use to toggle.
desc.singulo.neutrino_observatory.translation: 不斷掃描廣闊的區域並向附近的玩家展示礦石和廢墟。用於切換。

desc.singulo.neutrino_scanner.source: Reveals ruins and ores through terrain for 10 seconds.
desc.singulo.neutrino_scanner.translation: 透過地形顯露出廢墟和礦石，持續 10 秒。

desc.singulo.observation_log.source: A record from observation posts. Copy it onto data cards.
desc.singulo.observation_log.translation: 觀察站的記錄。將其複製到資料卡上。

desc.singulo.optical_lattice_substrate.source: Atoms held in a lattice of light.
desc.singulo.optical_lattice_substrate.translation: 原子被固定在光的晶格中。

desc.singulo.overclock_chip.source: Goes in a machine's upgrade slot: ×3 speed for ×4 power per tick. Cannot be combined with a monopole.
desc.singulo.overclock_chip.translation: 放入機器的升級槽：速度 ×3，但每 tick 耗電 ×4。不能與單極子同時使用。

desc.singulo.particle_accelerator.source: Collides particles into muon bundles and rare monopoles.
desc.singulo.particle_accelerator.translation: 將粒子碰撞成μ子束和稀有的單極子。

desc.singulo.penrose_reactor.source: Draws energy from a spinning black hole.
desc.singulo.penrose_reactor.translation: 從旋轉的黑洞中汲取能量。

desc.singulo.phase_sync_plate.source: Imprints cold-atom oscillations on an optical lattice. Phase-locks time crystals so they grow in 12 minutes instead of 20.
desc.singulo.phase_sync_plate.translation: 把冷卻原子的振動印在光晶格上的板。能讓時間晶體的振動相位一致，把培育時間從 20 分鐘縮短到 12 分鐘。

desc.singulo.precision_assembler.source: Assembles most parts and machines from tier 2 on.
desc.singulo.precision_assembler.translation: 組裝第 2 層以上的大部分零件和機器。

desc.singulo.pressure_crystal.source: An extremely hard blue crystal formed under deep-sea pressure. Used for the compactor anvil and degenerate precursors.
desc.singulo.pressure_crystal.translation: 在深海水壓下形成的極其堅硬的藍色晶體。用於簡併壓縮爐的鐵砧和簡併前驅體的晶種。

desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_light.source: A white panel with a softly glowing strip. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_light.translation: 帶有柔和發光條的白色面板。非常堅硬；需要鐵鎬或更好的鎬。

desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_panel.source: An unweathered white panel from deep ruins. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_panel.translation: 來自深層廢墟、未經風化的白色面板。非常堅硬；需要鐵鎬或更好的鎬。

desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_pillar.source: A white pillar from deep ruins. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_pillar.translation: 來自深層廢墟的白色柱子。非常堅硬；需要鐵鎬或更好的鎬。

desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_tiles.source: Unweathered white tiles from deep ruins. Very hard; needs an iron pickaxe or better.
desc.singulo.pristine_ruin_tiles.translation: 來自深層廢墟、未經風化的白色磁磚。非常堅硬；需要鐵鎬或更好的鎬。

desc.singulo.probe_station.source: Sends probes to discovered ruins to fetch loot.
desc.singulo.probe_station.translation: 向發現的廢墟發送探測器以獲取戰利品。

desc.singulo.quantum_key.source: Opens or seals a quantum-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.quantum_key.translation: 用於打開或封印量子鎖容器。每次使用都會消耗。

desc.singulo.raw_meteoric_iron.source: Smelt it in a blast furnace into meteoric iron.
desc.singulo.raw_meteoric_iron.translation: 在高爐中冶煉成隕鐵錠。

desc.singulo.reactor_mass_alarm.source: Replaces a shell on a reactor ring. Emits redstone when the core reaches its mass limit, stronger near collapse.
desc.singulo.reactor_mass_alarm.translation: 取代反應爐環上的外殼。當核心達到其質量極限時會發出紅石，在接近崩潰時會更強。

desc.singulo.reactor_shell.source: Shell of the reactor's three rings.

desc.singulo.reactor_stabilizer.source: Coils at the 45° points of the reactor rings.
desc.singulo.reactor_stabilizer.translation: 線圈位於反應器環的 45° 點處。

desc.singulo.record_fragment.source: An ancient storage medium: records etched by light inside glass. Read it in the Archive Terminal to add it to the handbook.
desc.singulo.record_fragment.translation: 古代的儲存媒介：用光把記錄刻在玻璃之中。在檔案終端讀取後會加入手冊。

desc.singulo.ruin_cache.source: Holds ruin loot and refills some days after it is emptied (not if moved). Hoppers and pipes cannot take from it.
desc.singulo.ruin_cache.translation: 存放廢墟回收物的保管庫。清空數天後內容會恢復（被移動過的不會）。漏斗和管道無法從中取出物品。

desc.singulo.ruin_glass.source: A cracked ancient window, as tough and blast-resistant as a ruin panel.
desc.singulo.ruin_glass.translation: 碎裂後殘留下來的古代窗戶，與廢墟面板一樣堅固且耐爆炸。

desc.singulo.ruin_lamp.source: An ancient lamp that still glows.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp.translation: 古老的燈，至今仍閃爍著光芒。

desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_amber.source: An amber ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_amber.translation: 在封印容器中發現的琥珀色古代燈。

desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_crimson.source: A crimson ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_crimson.translation: 在封印容器中發現的深紅色古代燈。

desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_verdant.source: A green ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_verdant.translation: 在封印容器中發現的綠色古代燈。

desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_violet.source: A violet ancient lamp found in sealed containers.
desc.singulo.ruin_lamp_violet.translation: 在封印容器中發現的紫色古代燈。

desc.singulo.scanner_module_2.source: Use with a Neutrino Scanner in your other hand, or on an observatory, to reach sensitivity 2: gold, diamond and emerald show up.
desc.singulo.scanner_module_2.translation: 另一隻手持微中子掃描器時使用，或對觀測站使用，可將靈敏度提升到 2：金、鑽石、綠寶石也會顯示。

desc.singulo.scanner_module_3.source: Raises sensitivity to 3: ancient debris and ores that need a diamond pickaxe show up.
desc.singulo.scanner_module_3.translation: 將靈敏度提升到 3：遠古殘骸和需要鑽石鎬的礦石也會顯示。

desc.singulo.scorched_ruin_panel.translation: 被煙灰燻黑的古建築板材。

desc.singulo.seal_console.source: Touch it to wake the Horizon Warden.
desc.singulo.seal_console.translation: 觸摸它即可喚醒 視界守衛。

desc.singulo.sealed_container_1.source: Opens with a Magnetic Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_1.translation: 用磁力鎖鑰匙打開；潛行時使用鑰匙可再次封印。強行破壞會連同內容物一起失去。

desc.singulo.sealed_container_2.source: Opens with a Quantum Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_2.translation: 用量子鎖鑰匙打開；潛行時使用鑰匙可再次封印。強行破壞會連同內容物一起失去。

desc.singulo.sealed_container_3.source: Opens with a Temporal Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_3.translation: 用時間鎖鑰匙打開；潛行時使用鑰匙可再次封印。強行破壞會連同內容物一起失去。

desc.singulo.sealed_container_4.source: Opens with a Singularity Key; sneak-use a key to seal it again. Breaking it by force destroys the contents.
desc.singulo.sealed_container_4.translation: 用奇點鎖鑰匙打開；潛行時使用鑰匙可再次封印。強行破壞會連同內容物一起失去。

desc.singulo.sealed_record.source: Right-click to read it and add a sealed ancient record to your handbook.
desc.singulo.sealed_record.translation: 右鍵閱讀，即可將一份被封印的古代記錄加入手冊。

desc.singulo.sentinel_core.source: The record crystal from the Echo Sentinel's chest. Built into the Echo Resonator, Time Crystal Incubator and Probe Station.
desc.singulo.sentinel_core.translation: 回聲守衛胸口的記錄晶體。用於回聲共鳴器、時間晶體培育槽與自動探測站。

desc.singulo.settings_card.source: Copies a machine's settings to another.
desc.singulo.settings_card.translation: 將一台機器的設定複製到另一台機器。

desc.singulo.shield_permit.source: Put it in a shield tower: only registered players may build, break or take items inside. Use to register yourself; use on a player to register them and you. Anyone can break the emitter crown.
desc.singulo.shield_permit.translation: 將其放入盾塔中：只有註冊玩家才能在其中建造、破壞或獲取物品。用於自己註冊；用於玩家註冊他們和您。任何人都可以打破發射器冠。

desc.singulo.shield_tower_body.source: Corners of the 3×3 body and the base of the spire.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_body.translation: 3×3 主體和尖塔底部的角落。

desc.singulo.shield_tower_coil.source: Inner 3×3 of the upper plinth layer.

desc.singulo.shield_tower_core.source: Front middle of the upper plinth layer.

desc.singulo.shield_tower_crown.source: The top of the tower; the dome is cast from here.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_crown.translation: 塔頂；圓頂是從這裡鑄造的。

desc.singulo.shield_tower_plinth.source: The 5×5 two-layer plinth; its upper edge takes I/O ports.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_plinth.translation: 5×5的兩層底座；它的上緣佔用 I/O 端口。

desc.singulo.shield_tower_waveguide.source: Middle of each body face; shows the rising energy.
desc.singulo.shield_tower_waveguide.translation: 每個身體臉部的中間；顯示出能量的上升。

desc.singulo.singularity_key.source: Opens or seals a singularity-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.singularity_key.translation: 用於打開或封印奇點鎖容器。每次使用都會消耗。

desc.singulo.singularity_seed.source: Becomes a black hole core when ignited.
desc.singulo.singularity_seed.translation: 被點燃後成為黑洞核心。

desc.singulo.spent_bose_condensate_catal.translation: 將其回收到較低層的催化劑中。

desc.singulo.spent_muon_catalyst.translation: 用過的催化劑。部分可回收。

desc.singulo.spent_singularity_core.translation: 將其回收到較低層的催化劑中。

desc.singulo.spent_time_crystal_catalyst.translation: 將其回收到較低層的催化劑中。

desc.singulo.stardust.source: Cosmic grains carrying rare isotopes. The raw material for cold atoms.
desc.singulo.stardust.translation: 從宇宙帶來的微粒，含有地球上沒有的稀有同位素。是冷卻原子的原料。

desc.singulo.stardust_cluster.source: Crystals of cosmic grains that grow on meteorite crust. Break them for stardust.
desc.singulo.stardust_cluster.translation: 長在隕石熔殼上的宇宙微粒晶體。破壞後掉落星塵。

desc.singulo.steel_blend.source: A mix of iron and coal. Smelt it in a blast furnace to get steel.
desc.singulo.steel_blend.translation: 鐵和煤的混合物。將其在高爐中熔煉以獲得鋼材。

desc.singulo.steel_ingot.source: The basic structural metal. Steel from other mods works too.
desc.singulo.steel_ingot.translation: 基本結構金屬。其他模組的鋼鐵也可以。

desc.singulo.steel_plate.source: Pressed steel used for casings and parts. Steel plates from other mods (forge:plates/steel) work too.
desc.singulo.steel_plate.translation: 用於外殼和零件的壓製鋼。其他模組的鋼板（forge:plates/steel）也可使用。

desc.singulo.strange_matter.source: Ultra-dense matter left by strangelets. Worth 100 mass and usable for degenerate shells.
desc.singulo.strange_matter.translation: 奇異子留下的超緻密物質。質量為 100，可用於簡併殼。

desc.singulo.strangelet.source: Converts nearby blocks into strange matter. Contain it with a Magnetic Bottle.
desc.singulo.strangelet.translation: 將附近的方塊轉化為奇怪的物質。用 磁瓶 包含它。

desc.singulo.striped_ruin_panel.source: Ancient panel with a long-dead light band.
desc.singulo.striped_ruin_panel.translation: 留有早已熄滅的光帶的古建築板材。

desc.singulo.superconducting_cable.translation: 第 2 層無損高容量電纜。

desc.singulo.superconducting_coil.source: A zero-resistance coil, core of tier 2 tech.
desc.singulo.superconducting_coil.translation: 零電阻線圈，二級技術的核心。

desc.singulo.superconducting_wire.translation: 用於線圈和電纜的電線。

desc.singulo.temporal_key.source: Opens or seals a temporal-lock container. Used up each time.
desc.singulo.temporal_key.translation: 用於打開或封印時間鎖容器。每次使用都會消耗。

desc.singulo.thermocouple_module.source: Turns a temperature difference into electricity.

desc.singulo.thermoelectric_generator.source: Place it between something hot and something cold to generate power. Your first generator. Magma block + blue ice gives about 76 FE/t without melting.
desc.singulo.thermoelectric_generator.translation: 將其放在熱的東西和冷的東西之間即可發電。你的第一台發電機。岩漿塊＋藍冰不會融化，約 76 FE/t。

desc.singulo.tiled_ruin_panel.translation: 鋪有細小磁磚的古建築板材。

desc.singulo.time_crystal_catalyst.source: Tier 4 catalyst used by most advanced devices.
desc.singulo.time_crystal_catalyst.translation: 最先進設備使用的 Tier 4 觸媒。

desc.singulo.time_crystal_incubator.source: Grows time crystal catalysts. Underpowering lowers their purity.
desc.singulo.time_crystal_incubator.translation: 生長時間晶體催化劑。動力不足會降低其純度。

desc.singulo.time_crystal_seed.translation: 時間晶體催化劑的種子。

desc.singulo.tipler_bearing.source: Top and bottom centre; carries the cylinder axle.
desc.singulo.tipler_bearing.translation: 頂部和底部中心；承載氣缸軸。

desc.singulo.tipler_core.source: Middle of the front, second layer, of the 5×5×9 housing.

desc.singulo.tipler_cylinder.translation: 將時間加快 8 個區塊內。

desc.singulo.tipler_frame.source: Frame along the 12 edges of the housing.
desc.singulo.tipler_frame.translation: 沿著外殼的 12 個邊緣進行框架。

desc.singulo.tipler_holder.source: Either side of each window, middle layer.
desc.singulo.tipler_holder.translation: 每個視窗的兩側，中間一層。

desc.singulo.tipler_housing.source: Housing; any panel can be swapped for an I/O port.
desc.singulo.tipler_housing.translation: 住房;任何面板都可以更換為 I/O 連接埠。

desc.singulo.tipler_window.source: Five-high slit in each side; shows the spinning cylinder.
desc.singulo.tipler_window.translation: 每側有五高開衩；顯示旋轉圓筒。

desc.singulo.unfired_ceramic.source: Clay, sand, Nether quartz and bone meal, ready to be fired into white ceramic.
desc.singulo.unfired_ceramic.translation: 黏土、沙、下界石英和骨粉，準備燒成白色陶瓷。

desc.singulo.unstable_wormhole_mouth.translation: 除非在 60 秒內穩定下來否則就會崩潰。

desc.singulo.vented_ruin_panel.translation: 帶通風口的古建築板材。

desc.singulo.void_collector.source: Place it in the End over open void to gather one Void Dust a minute. Needs no power.
desc.singulo.void_collector.translation: 在終界放在正下方直到虛空都空無一物的地方，每分鐘收集 1 個虛空之塵。不需要電力。

desc.singulo.void_dust.source: Dust condensed from the fluctuations of empty space, gathered only above the End void. Steadies space in singularity tech.
desc.singulo.void_dust.translation: 只有在終界虛空上方才能收集到、由空間本身的漲落凝成的塵埃。在奇點技術中用來穩定空間。

desc.singulo.white_ceramic_composite.source: The white ceramic used for casings and circuit boards.
desc.singulo.white_ceramic_composite.translation: 用於外殼和電路板的白色陶瓷。

desc.singulo.white_glass_panel.source: A see-through panel in the White Panel style.
desc.singulo.white_glass_panel.translation: 與白色面板同系列的可透視面板。

desc.singulo.white_light_panel.source: A white panel that glows brightly (light 15).
desc.singulo.white_light_panel.translation: 明亮發光的白色面板（亮度 15）。

desc.singulo.white_panel.source: A clean, seamless white panel for your own buildings.
desc.singulo.white_panel.translation: 可以自己製作的乾淨無縫白色面板，用於你自己的建築。

desc.singulo.white_star_glass_panel.source: A see-through white panel with a four-pointed star.
desc.singulo.white_star_glass_panel.translation: 帶有四芒星圖案的可透視白色面板。

desc.singulo.worldline_anchor_advanced.source: Advanced chunk loader. Embedding a Singularity Core makes it free and maximal.
desc.singulo.worldline_anchor_advanced.translation: 高級區塊載入器。嵌入 奇點核心 使其免費且最大化。

desc.singulo.worldline_anchor_small.source: Keeps nearby chunks loaded while fed a catalyst.
desc.singulo.worldline_anchor_small.translation: 在供給催化劑的同時保持附近的塊加載。

desc.singulo.wormhole_generator.source: Creates a pair of wormhole mouths from 100 MFE/t for 10 s.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator.translation: 使用 100 個 MFE/t 建立一對蟲洞口，持續 10 秒。

desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_port.source: Replaces a generator shell. Feeds power to the core and pushes finished mouths out.
desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_port.translation: 代替發生器外殼放置。把電力送入核心，並把完成的入口推送出去。

desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_shell.source: Sphere shell; any can be swapped for an I/O port.

desc.singulo.wormhole_generator_window.source: Middle of each face at the equator; shows the vortex.

desc.singulo.wormhole_mouth_casing.source: An open frame that holds a stabilized throat. One per wormhole mouth.

desc.singulo.wormhole_port.source: Within 8 blocks of a mouth, links machines to the port with the same number (0-127) near the twin mouth. A mouth runs 8, 32 or 128 ports by throat size, nearest first. Glows while active.
desc.singulo.wormhole_port.translation: 在入口 8 格內時，把機器連接到另一端入口附近編號相同（0-127）的埠。每個入口依喉部大小可讓 8、32 或 128 個埠運作，依距離由近到遠。運作時會發光。

guide.singulo.catalysts.slots.body.source: Catalyst machines have a dedicated slot that accepts only catalysts. Spent catalysts can be recycled into about 25% of a lower-tier catalyst.

guide.singulo.catalysts.tiers.body.source: Muon (2), BE (3), Time crystal (4), Singularity core (5). Higher tier = faster and less wear; one lower = half speed and double wear; two lower = unusable. Underpowering wears catalysts faster.

guide.singulo.catalysts.time.body.source: Near a running reactor catalysts wear at ×0.5; inside a T-Cylinder field ×2. The two cancel out.
guide.singulo.catalysts.time.body.translation: 運轉中的反應器附近催化劑磨損×0.5；蒂普勒圓柱 字段內 ×2。兩者抵消。

guide.singulo.hazards.list.body.source:
- Tidal zone ignores armour.
- Leaking hydrogen near fire explodes.
- Large accelerators may leak strangelets that convert blocks into strange matter; contain them with a Magnetic Bottle.
guide.singulo.hazards.list.body.translation:
- 潮汐區忽略裝甲。
- 洩漏的氫氣靠近火源會爆炸。
- 大型加速器可能會洩漏奇異子，將塊轉化為奇異物質；使用 磁瓶 包含它們。

guide.singulo.intro.basics.body.source:
Power (FE) travels through Singulo cables; items and fluids use per-side settings and other mods' pipes.
From stage 2 you use catalysts: consumables with a lifetime, placed in a dedicated catalyst slot. One tier above the machine is faster; one below is slower and wears faster; two below cannot be used.
Ancient ruins hold records and parts you cannot craft. Start looking for Observation Posts early.
guide.singulo.intro.basics.body.translation:
電源 (FE) 透過 Singulo 電纜傳輸；物品和流體使用每側設定和其他模組的管道。
從第 2 階段開始，您將使用催化劑：具有使用壽命的消耗品，並放置在專用的催化劑槽中。機器上面一層速度較快；下面的一種速度較慢，磨損得較快；以下兩個不能使用。
古代遺跡保存著你無法製作的記錄和零件。儘早開始尋找觀察站。

guide.singulo.intro.howto.body.source:
- Pick a chapter on the left; flip pages with the arrows.
- The Progress chapter shows finished and next goals (same as the Singulo advancement tab).
- Hover items for a description; hold Shift for recipes and uses.
- Use the Holo Projector on a multiblock controller to see its shape.
guide.singulo.intro.howto.body.translation:
- 選擇左側的章節；用箭頭翻頁。
- 進度章節顯示已完成的目標和下一個目標（與 Singulo 進度標籤相同）。
- 將滑鼠停留在項目上即可查看描述；按住 Shift 鍵以查看食譜和用途。
- 在多塊控制器上使用 全像投影器 查看其形狀。

guide.singulo.intro.welcome.body.source:
Singulo is a tech mod about extracting energy from mass. Start with thermoelectric power, climb through cryogenic, quantum and temporal tech, and finally run a spinning black hole.
There are five stages. Read the stage chapters in order to know what to build next.
guide.singulo.intro.welcome.body.translation:
Singulo 是一個關於從質量中提取能量的技術模組。從熱電開始，透過低溫、量子和時間技術，最後運行一個旋轉的黑洞。
有五個階段。閱讀階段章節以了解下一步要建構什麼。

guide.singulo.multiblocks.list.body.source: cooling_tower, particle_accelerator, degenerate_compactor, casimir_cavity, degenerate_furnace, penrose_reactor, event_horizon_shield, tipler_cylinder, wormhole_generator.
guide.singulo.multiblocks.list.body.translation: 冷卻水塔、粒子加速器、退化壓縮器、casimir_cavity、退化_爐、彭羅斯_反應器、事件地平線_屏蔽、tipler_汽缸、蟲洞_發電機。

guide.singulo.multiblocks.projector.body.source:
1. Place the controller; the structure extends behind it.
2. Use the projector on it to see the shape and a material list.
3. Fill the cyan boxes, clear the red ones. It lights up when complete.
4. Sneak-use to change size.
In creative: /singulo build <name> [size].
guide.singulo.multiblocks.projector.body.translation:
1、放置控制器；該結構在其後面延伸。
2. 使用投影機查看形狀和材料清單。
3. 填滿青色框，清除紅色框。完成後它會亮起。
4. 偷偷使用來改變尺寸。
在創意中：/singulo build <姓名> [尺寸]。

guide.singulo.power.cables.body.source: Copper wire → superconducting cable → topological wire → horizon bus. A network carries what its weakest cable can.
guide.singulo.power.cables.body.translation: 銅線→超導電纜→拓樸線→水平匯流排。網路可以承載其最薄弱的電纜所能承載的能力。

guide.singulo.power.sides.body.source: Use the Sides button in an ordinary processing machine screen to set each face to off / input / output / both, with optional auto-eject. Multiblocks use designated I/O ports; the P-Reactor uses Extraction Ports. Machines that output two gases, such as the electrolyzer, have a tab for each gas. The power button stops a machine, and machines that can make something from power alone have a switch to skip those recipes.
guide.singulo.power.sides.body.translation: 使用普通加工機畫面中的「側面」按鈕將每個面設定為關閉/輸入/輸出/兩者，並可選擇自動彈出。多塊使用指定的 I/O 連接埠； 彭羅斯反應爐 使用擷取埠。輸出兩種氣體的裝置（如電解槽）可為每種氣體分別設定輸出面。電源按鈕可讓裝置停止；能只靠電力製造產物的裝置有開關，可跳過這些配方。

guide.singulo.power.wormhole.body.source: The only wireless link. Generate a pair of mouths, stabilize them within 60 s using exotic matter and a mouth casing, then carry one away and place it. A port within 8 blocks of a mouth links to the port with the same number (0-127, set with the seven circles in its screen) near the twin mouth, joining power, items and fluids. Each mouth runs 8, 32 or 128 ports depending on its throat size, nearest first, and active ports glow. Throughput also grows with the throat and is unlimited at 7x7. Mouths run on exotic matter and close when it runs out; a newly placed mouth stays open for 5 minutes without fuel.
guide.singulo.power.wormhole.body.translation: 唯一的無線連結。產生一對入口，在 60 秒內用奇異物質和入口外殼將其穩定，然後帶走其中一個並放置。入口 8 格內的埠會與另一端入口附近編號相同（0-127，在介面中用 7 個圓圈設定）的埠相連，直接連通電力、物品和液體。每個入口依喉部大小可讓 8、32 或 128 個埠運作，依距離由近到遠，運作中的埠會發光。可傳輸的量也隨喉部變大，7×7 時不受上限限制。入口以奇異物質維持，耗盡時會關閉；新放置的入口無需燃料也會保持開啟 5 分鐘。

guide.singulo.romance.darkmatter.body.source: Collect near a core, store in containment tanks, feed the core directly.
guide.singulo.romance.darkmatter.body.translation: 在岩心附近收集，儲存在密封槽中，直接向岩心供料。

guide.singulo.romance.gear.body.source: Metric Drive, Graviton Manipulator, Advanced Worldline Anchor.
guide.singulo.romance.gear.body.translation: 度規驅動器、重力子操控器、高級世界線錨。

guide.singulo.romance.shield.body.source: Protects a 32-block radius. With a Singularity Core it also blocks hostile spawns.
guide.singulo.romance.shield.body.translation: 保護 32 格半徑。使用 奇點核心，它還可以阻止敵對生成。

guide.singulo.romance.tipler.body.source: Doubles supported machine processing within 16 blocks.
guide.singulo.romance.tipler.body.translation: 16 塊內支援的機器處理量翻倍。

guide.singulo.ruins.bosses.body.source:
The caches of the Research Building, Culture Facility and Final Lab stay sealed until you defeat their guardian. When the loot regrows the cache reseals and the guardian returns; guardians also reset if every challenger leaves.
- Echo Sentinel (Research Building archive): a security hologram that orbits you firing homing bolts and blinks behind you to strike when you stop watching it. The Echo Projectors in the corners shield it and fire light lances in volleys (move when the golden aim lines appear); step out of a projected circle before its pillar rises. Break the projectors first. Below half health it summons one-hit echoes; projector beams only reach the real one. Drops Sentinel Projection Cores.
- Gravity Remnant (Culture Facility containment chamber): a black core that bursts from its tank. While its rubble shell lasts it takes reduced damage and loses a piece per hit; it fires the rubble at you. It lifts nearby foes and slams them down, so Gravity Boots or Impact Generators help. Below half health a gravity well drags you toward the core. Drops Degenerate Nuclei.
- Horizon Warden (Final Lab): touch the central Seal Console to wake it.
guide.singulo.ruins.bosses.body.translation:
研究棟、封鎖培養設施和最終實驗設施的寶庫，在擊敗各自的守衛之前都被力場封鎖。內容物再生後會重新封鎖，守衛也會回來；所有挑戰者離開房間時，守衛也會復原。
- 回聲守衛（研究棟的檔案室）：一進入房間就會出現的警衛全像投影。它在空中繞著你飛行並發射追蹤光彈，一旦你不再看著它，就會瞬移到你背後斬擊（瞬移前會聚集光芒）。回聲投影器不僅保護守衛，還會一齊射出光之槍（出現金色瞄準線時要移動）；腳下映出光陣時，要在光柱升起前走出陣外。投影器剩得越多，攻擊越難奏效，所以先把它們打掉。體力低於一半時會召喚一擊即消的分身；投影器的光只會連向本體。掉落守衛投影核心。
- 重力殘渣（封鎖培養設施的隔離槽室）：衝破收容槽而出的黑色核心。瓦礫外殼還在時受到的傷害較小，每受一擊剝落一塊；它會把瓦礫射向你。它會把周圍的對手抬起再砸向地面，因此重力靴或衝擊發電面板會很有幫助。體力低於一半時會形成重力井，把你拉向核心（碰到核心會受傷）。掉落簡併核。
- 視界守衛（最終實驗設施）：觸碰中央的密封控制台即可喚醒。

guide.singulo.ruins.compass.body.source: At first the compass only finds Observation Posts. Sneak-use it on the cache of a ruin you have cleared to tune it for the next one: Research Building, then Culture Facility, then Final Lab. Underground ruins lie below the spot it points to.
guide.singulo.ruins.compass.body.translation: 羅盤起初只能搜尋地表觀測站。潛行右鍵你已攻略的廢墟的廢墟緩存，即可調校以搜尋下一處：研究棟，然後是封閉培養設施，最後是最終實驗室。地下廢墟位於指針所指位置的下方。

guide.singulo.ruins.gathering.body.source:
- Meteor craters (plains, deserts, forests and other surface biomes): a shallow bowl about 10 blocks across with a half-buried meteorite. Mine meteoric iron chunks (iron pickaxe or better) for raw meteoric iron and stardust clusters on the black crust for stardust. Clusters slowly regrow, but only on crust still in its crater.
- Fulgurite: lightning striking sand turns it into fulgurite. Stand a lightning rod on sand and it forms under the rod in thunderstorms. The stage 3 Keraunos Discharge Tower fires artificial lightning at a rod on demand.
- Pressure crystals (stage 3): a Deep-Sea Pressure Collector on the sea floor with 16+ blocks of water above slowly makes them; deeper is faster.
- Void dust (stages 4-5): a Void Collector in the End, placed over open void, gathers it.
guide.singulo.ruins.gathering.body.translation:
- 隕石坑（平原、沙漠、森林等地表生態域）：直徑約 10 格的淺碗狀坑，中心有半埋的隕石。用鐵鎬或更好的鎬開採隕鐵塊得到粗隕鐵，從黑色熔殼上長出的星塵晶簇得到星塵。星塵晶簇會慢慢重新長出，但只限於原本就在隕石坑裡的熔殼。
- 閃電熔岩：閃電擊中沙子會把沙子變成閃電熔岩塊。把避雷針立在沙子上，每逢雷雨就會在避雷針下方形成。有了第 3 階段的克勞諾斯放電塔，可以隨時用電力向避雷針發射人工閃電。
- 高壓晶體（第 3 階段）：把深海壓力收集器放在上方有 16 格以上海水的海底，會被水壓慢慢壓成（越深越快）。
- 虛空之塵（第 4~5 階段）：把虛空收集器放在終界正下方直到虛空都空無一物的地方即可收集。

guide.singulo.ruins.gathering.title.translation: 只能在特定地點獲得的素材

guide.singulo.ruins.list.body.source: Observation Post, Research Building, Culture Facility, Final Lab — each guards loot for one catalyst tier.
guide.singulo.ruins.list.body.translation: 地表觀測站、研究棟、封閉培養設施、最終實驗室 — 每個守衛一層催化劑的戰利品。

guide.singulo.ruins.records.body.source: Ruin caches sometimes hold crystal memories. Decode them in the Archive Terminal to unlock the Ancient Records chapter.
guide.singulo.ruins.records.body.translation: 廢墟保管庫裡有時會出現水晶記憶體。在檔案終端讀取後，就能解鎖「古代文明的記錄」一章。

guide.singulo.ruins.sealed.body.source: Each ruin hides a sealed container that opens only with the key of the next stage: magnetic, quantum, temporal, then singularity. Keys are made in the Precision Assembler and used up each time. Inside are materials, coloured lamps and sometimes a rare item found nowhere else: Overclock Chip, Gravity Boots, Catalyst Stabilizer or Dimensional Pocket. Breaking a sealed container destroys its contents. You can craft containers too, and sneak-use a key to seal one.
guide.singulo.ruins.sealed.body.translation: 每座廢墟都藏著一個封印容器，只能用下一階段的鑰匙打開：磁力鎖、量子鎖、時間鎖，最後是奇點鎖。鑰匙在精密組裝台製造，每次使用都會消耗。裡面有材料、彩色燈，有時還有別處找不到的稀有道具：超頻晶片、重力靴、催化劑穩定劑或次元口袋。強行破壞封印中的容器會連同內容物一起失去。你也可以自己製作容器，潛行時使用鑰匙即可封印。

guide.singulo.stage1.goal.body.source: The key is the Superconducting Coil, made in the Cryogenic Cooling Tower. It needs a Control Unit from an Observation Post. Find one, restore the unit in the Archive Terminal, then build the tower.
guide.singulo.stage1.goal.body.translation: 密鑰是 超導線圈，由 低溫冷卻塔 製成。它需要 地表觀測站 中的 控制單元。找到一個，恢復 檔案終端 中的單元，然後建造塔。

guide.singulo.stage1.machines.body.source:
- Kiln: fires ceramic boards and steel.
- Compressor: plates, and mass mode for compressed blocks.
- Electrolyzer: water to hydrogen and oxygen.
- Archive Terminal: copies records, restores parts, decodes fragments.
guide.singulo.stage1.machines.body.translation:
- 燒製爐：燃燒陶瓷板和鋼材。
- 壓縮機：板和壓縮塊的質量模式。
- 電解槽：水轉化為氫氣和氧氣。
- 檔案終端：複製記錄、恢復部分、解碼片段。

guide.singulo.stage1.materials.body.source:
1. Iron + coal = steel blend; smelt it in a blast furnace.
2. Clay, quartz, bone meal and sand make unfired ceramic; fire it into white ceramic.
3. Make basic circuits and basic frames. Most machines need these.
guide.singulo.stage1.materials.body.translation:
1.鐵+煤=鋼混合物；在高爐中熔煉它。
2、黏土、石英、骨粉和砂製成未燒製的陶瓷；將其燒成白色陶瓷。
3.製作基本電路和基本框架。大多數機器都需要這些。

guide.singulo.stage1.power.body.source:
The Thermoelectric Generator produces power from a temperature difference (0.10 FE/t per kelvin): put something hot (a magma block, a lit campfire or kiln) on one side and something cold (blue ice, packed ice) on the other.
Each cold block only tolerates so much difference; beyond that it melts into another block (water evaporates). See the next page for pairs that last.
Connect machines with copper wire.
guide.singulo.stage1.power.body.translation:
熱電發電機透過溫差發電（每 1 K 溫差 0.10 FE/t）：在一側放熱的東西（岩漿塊、點燃的營火或燒製爐），另一側放冷的東西（藍冰、浮冰）。
每種冷方塊能承受的溫差有限，超過後會融化成別的方塊（水會蒸發）。不會融化的組合見下一頁。
用銅導線連接機器。

guide.singulo.stage1.thermal_pairs.body.source:
Pairs whose cold block never melts (output of one generator):
- Magma block + blue ice: about 76 FE/t (best)
- Running kiln + blue ice: about 66 FE/t
- Campfire + blue ice: about 56 FE/t
- Campfire + packed ice: about 55 FE/t
Lava is too hot: even blue ice turns into packed ice in about 40 s and keeps melting. Campfires with water, snow or ice melt them in under a minute.
To run the stage 2 Cryogenic Cooling Tower (240 FE/t for liquid nitrogen), plan on 4 or more generators with magma + blue ice, or 5 or more with campfire + packed ice (before copper wire losses).
guide.singulo.stage1.thermal_pairs.body.translation:
冷方塊可以一直使用而不融化的組合（每台發電機的輸出）：
- 岩漿塊＋藍冰：約 76 FE/t（最推薦）
- 運轉中的燒製爐＋藍冰：約 66 FE/t
- 營火＋藍冰：約 56 FE/t
- 營火＋浮冰：約 55 FE/t
熔岩太熱：即使是藍冰也會在約 40 秒內變成浮冰並繼續融化。營火搭配水、雪或冰，不到 1 分鐘就會融化。
要運轉第 2 階段的低溫冷卻塔（液氮 240 FE/t），岩漿塊＋藍冰大約需要 4 台以上，營火＋浮冰則需要 5 台以上（不含銅導線損耗）。

guide.singulo.stage2.accelerator.body.source: Build a square ring of tubes and magnets (8–32 wide), magnets on the corners and on at least a quarter of the ring. It turns hydrogen into muon bundles (and rare monopoles). The Catalytic Reactor turns them into muon catalysts.
guide.singulo.stage2.accelerator.body.translation: 用管子和磁鐵（8-32 寬）製作一個方形環，在角落和環的至少四分之一上放置磁鐵。它將氫轉化為μ子束（和罕見的單極子）。 催化反應器 將它們變成μ子催化劑。

guide.singulo.stage2.accelerator.title.translation: 粒子加速器和μ子催化劑

guide.singulo.stage2.goal.body.source: You need liquid helium (tower 10+ high, helium from crushed deepslate) and quantum data from Research Buildings.
guide.singulo.stage2.goal.body.translation: 您需要液態氦（塔 10+ 高，來自壓碎的深板岩的氦）和來自研究大樓的量子資料。

guide.singulo.stage2.others.body.source:
- Precision Assembler: makes almost everything from stage 3 on.
- Cryogenic Turbine: power from evaporating nitrogen.
- SMES Cell: stores energy.
- Small Worldline Anchor: chunk loader fed by catalysts.
- Monopole Upgrade: ×2 speed, +50% efficiency in a machine's monopole slot.
guide.singulo.stage2.others.body.translation:
- 精密組裝台：從第 3 階段開始幾乎製作所有內容。
- 低溫渦輪機：來自蒸發氮氣的動力。
- SMES 電池：儲存能量。
- 小型世界線錨：由催化劑供應的區塊裝載機。
- 單極子升級模組：×2 速度，機器單極槽效率 +50%。

guide.singulo.stage2.tower.body.source: A waisted 5×5 tower, 7–15 high, with heat exchange cores up the middle. It makes liquid nitrogen from air and superconducting coils.
guide.singulo.stage2.tower.body.translation: 腰部 5×5 塔，7-15 高，熱交換核心位於中間。它從空氣和超導線圈中製造液態氮。

guide.singulo.stage3.goal.body.source: The key is exotic matter from the C-Cavity, which needs time crystal catalysts. Search the deep Culture Facility.
guide.singulo.stage3.goal.body.translation: 關鍵是來自卡西米爾腔的奇異物質，它需要時間晶體催化劑。深入搜尋封閉培養設施。

guide.singulo.stage3.quantum.body.source:
- Entanglement Synthesizer: entangled elements, two at a time.
- Laser Cooler: cold atoms, lattices, BE condensate catalyst.
- Quantum Heat Engine: catalyst-driven generator.
guide.singulo.stage3.quantum.body.translation:
- 量子糾纏合成器：糾纏元素，一次兩個。
- 雷射冷卻器：冷原子、晶格、BE凝聚催化劑。
- 量子熱機：催化劑驅動發電機。

guide.singulo.stage3.tools.body.source:
- Inertial Control Gauntlet: levitate or pull small mobs.
- Inertial Stabilizer: explosion-proofs a 16-block radius.
- Gravitational Wave Detector: points to anomalies.
- Neutrino Scanner: shows ruins and ores through terrain.
guide.singulo.stage3.tools.body.translation:
- 慣性控制手套：懸浮或拉動小生物。
- 慣性穩定器：16 格半徑內防爆。
- 重力波探測器：指向異常。
- 微中子掃描器：透過地形顯示廢墟和礦石。

guide.singulo.stage4.compression.body.source: Mass mode turns materials with mass values into compressed blocks, Lv1 to Lv3. Lv1 made from 3+ kinds of blocks is "mixed" and only 8 are needed for Lv2. The Degenerate Compactor (closed 5×5×5 press) makes degenerate shells.
guide.singulo.stage4.compression.body.translation: 質量模式將具有質量值的材料轉換為壓縮塊，從 Lv1 到 Lv3。 Lv1由3種以上的塊組成，是「混合」的，而Lv2只需要8種。 簡併壓縮爐（封閉式 5×5×5 壓力機）製造退化外殼。

guide.singulo.stage4.goal.body.source: Wake and defeat the Horizon Warden at the Final Lab to get a dormant singularity seed, awaken it in the encapsulator and ignite it in the P-Reactor.
guide.singulo.stage4.goal.body.translation: 在最終實驗室處喚醒並擊敗視界守衛以獲得休眠的奇點種子，在封裝器中喚醒它並在彭羅斯反應爐中點燃它。

guide.singulo.stage4.power.body.source:
- Degenerate Furnace (5×5×7): 20 MFE/t from Lv2 blocks; power leaves through I/O ports.
- Probe Station: automates trips to discovered ruins.
- Topological wire and SMES modules for large power.
guide.singulo.stage4.power.body.translation:
- 簡併熱爐 (5×5×7)：來自 Lv2 區塊的 20 個 MFE/t；電源供應器透過 I/O 連接埠離開。
- 探測站：自動前往已發現的廢墟。
- 用於高功率的拓樸線和SMES模組。

guide.singulo.stage4.time.body.source: The incubator grows time crystals over 20 minutes of real running time; underpowering lowers purity. The C-Cavity (5×5×5, mirror top and bottom) makes exotic matter.
guide.singulo.stage4.time.body.translation: 孵化器在實際運轉時間內生長時間晶體超過 20 分鐘；動力不足會降低純度。 卡西米爾腔（5×5×5，鏡面頂部和底部）製造奇異物質。

guide.singulo.stage5.byproducts.body.source: Collectors produce jet condensate, H-Condensate and exotic matter. The Singularity Core is the tier 5 catalyst.
guide.singulo.stage5.byproducts.body.translation: 收集器產生噴射冷凝水、霍金凝聚體 和奇異物質。 奇點核心 是第 5 層催化劑。

guide.singulo.stage5.byproducts.title.translation: 副產品和 奇點核心

guide.singulo.stage5.endgame.body.source: With cores and power you can run the late-game devices: shields, T-Cylinders and wormholes.
guide.singulo.stage5.endgame.body.translation: 有了核心和力量，你就可以運行遊戲後期的設備：護盾、T 型氣缸和蟲洞。

guide.singulo.stage5.ignite.body.source: Insert the seed, press Ignite and deliver 50 GFE within 10 s. Burn mass pellets; efficiency depends on spin. Mind the 24-block pull zone (time runs slower there) and the 4-block tidal zone.
guide.singulo.stage5.ignite.body.translation: 插入種子，按下「點燃」並在 10 秒內交付 50 個 GFE。燃燒大量顆粒；效率取決於旋轉。注意 24 塊拉動區（那裡時間過得較慢）和 4 塊潮汐區。

guide.singulo.stage5.reactor.body.source: Three continuous orthogonal rings of radius 6 (48 blocks each): gyro drives where they cross, twelve stabilizer coils at the 45° points, reactor shell elsewhere (replace shell blocks with extraction ports or mass alarms), an empty 3×3×3 core. The core controller sits 5 below the centre.
guide.singulo.stage5.reactor.body.translation: 三個半徑為 6 的連續正交環（每個環 48 個塊）：交叉處的陀螺儀驅動器、45° 點處的 12 個穩定器線圈、其他地方的反應堆外殼（用提取端口或質量警報器替換外殼塊）、一個空的 3×3×3 核心。核心控制器位於中心下方 5 處。

holo.singulo.not_controller.source: Use it on a multiblock controller
holo.singulo.not_controller.translation: 在多塊控制器上使用它

record.singulo.h01.body.source: Each container was locked with the key of the next stage, so that only those who reached it could open what came before. We give nothing to those in a hurry.
record.singulo.h01.body.translation: 每個容器都用下一階段的鑰匙鎖上，只有到達那個階段的人，才能打開之前留下的遺產。我們不會把任何東西交給急躁的人。

record.singulo.h02.body.source: In case the reactor ran away, some staff were to sleep inside a time field. The field for the waking date was never filled in.
record.singulo.h02.body.translation: 為防反應爐失控，曾計畫讓部分職員在時間場中沉睡。醒來日期那一欄，直到最後都是空白。

record.singulo.h03.body.source: If you are reading this, you too have lit the reactor. We will not tell you to turn back. Only keep a watcher at the limit beside you, and never silence the alarm.
record.singulo.h03.body.translation: 如果你正在讀這份記錄，你也點燃了反應爐吧。我們不會叫你回頭。只是，請在身邊安排一個看守極限的人，並且絕不要關掉警報。

record.singulo.r01.body.source: Surface observation begins today. Our goal is simple: turn mass into energy, all of it. Stone, wood, the sea — all of it is frozen energy.
record.singulo.r01.body.translation: 表面觀測從今天開始。我們的目標很簡單：將質量轉化為能量。石頭、木頭、海洋——所有這些都是冰凍的能量。

record.singulo.r02.body.source: Thermoelectric efficiency is below 0.0001%. Burning fuel for a gradient is like moving a mountain to pick up a grain of sand. Still, this is where we must begin.
record.singulo.r02.body.translation: 熱電效率低於0.0001%。為梯度燃燒燃料就像移山拾取一粒沙一樣。儘管如此，這仍然是我們必須開始的地方。

record.singulo.r03.body.source: All casings shall be white, so that every stain shows. Anomalies must be found while they are still visible.
record.singulo.r03.body.translation: 所有腸衣應為白色，以便每個污點都清晰可見。必須在異常現象仍然可見時發現它們。

record.singulo.r04.body.source: Unmanned guards are stationed at every post. They do not tell intruders from staff. Anyone who carries records out is an intruder.
record.singulo.r04.body.translation: 每個哨所都駐有無人值守的警衛。他們不會告訴入侵者和工作人員。任何攜帶記錄的人都是入侵者。

record.singulo.r05.body.source: At zero resistance a current flows forever. We have obtained eternity — but only at 77 kelvin.
record.singulo.r05.body.translation: 在零電阻下，電流永遠流動。我們已經獲得了永恆——但僅限於 77 開爾文。

record.singulo.r06.body.source: One collision in a thousand yields a magnet with only a north pole. The theorists were delighted. The engineers, finding it doubled a machine's speed, were more delighted still.
record.singulo.r06.body.translation: 千分之一的碰撞會產生只有北極的磁鐵。理論家們很高興。工程師發現它使機器的速度提高了一倍，更加高興了。

record.singulo.r07.body.source: Someone argued catalysts should never wear out. Rejected: it is because they wear out that we reach for the next tier.
record.singulo.r07.body.translation: 有人認為催化劑永遠不會磨損。拒絕：正是因為它們磨損了，我們才進入下一層。

record.singulo.r08.body.source: When an anchor stops, time stops in its region. Those inside never notice. Not noticing was deemed not to be a problem.
record.singulo.r08.body.translation: 當錨停止時，時間在其區域​​停止。裡面的人永遠不會注意到。沒有註意到被認為不是問題。

record.singulo.r09.body.source: Entangled elements are always born in pairs. Break one and the other loses its meaning. Will our cities be the same?
record.singulo.r09.body.translation: 糾纏元素總是成對出現。打破其中一個，另一個就失去了意義。我們的城市也會一樣嗎？

record.singulo.r10.body.source: In a Bose condensate every atom becomes one wave. One researcher called it a choir. She left the division that week.
record.singulo.r10.body.translation: 在玻色凝聚中，每個原子都變成一種波。一位研究人員稱之為合唱團。那週她離開了該部門。

record.singulo.r11.body.source: Something far away shook spacetime. We know the direction and the distance band. What we do not know is whether it was natural.
record.singulo.r11.body.translation: 遠處有東西震動了時空。我們知道方向和距離範圍。我們不知道這是否是自然的。

record.singulo.r12.body.source: The research building is closed. No reason will be published. The lock codes have been replaced with redstone signals.
record.singulo.r12.body.translation: 研究大樓已關閉。不會公佈任何原因。鎖碼已被紅石訊號取代。

record.singulo.r13.body.source: A time crystal ticks forever without spending energy. At last we can grow clocks themselves.
record.singulo.r13.body.translation: 時間晶體會永遠滴答作響，而不消耗能量。最後我們可以自己種時鐘了。

record.singulo.r14.body.source: Put two mirrors around nothing and you get less than nothing. Negative energy. We turned it into matter.
record.singulo.r14.body.translation: 在什麼都沒有的地方放兩面鏡子，你就什麼都得不到。負能量。我們把它變成物質了。

record.singulo.r15.body.source: Cryogenic control failed. Some seeds slipped out of the flow of time. The section is sealed. Staff remain inside.
record.singulo.r15.body.translation: 低溫控制失敗。有些種子隨著時間的流逝而溜走了。該部分被密封。工作人員留在裡面。

record.singulo.r15.title.translation: 封閉培養設施 最終報告

record.singulo.r16.body.source: A teaspoon of neutron-star matter weighs as much as a mountain. We cut it into blocks and stacked it neatly.
record.singulo.r16.body.translation: 一茶匙中子星物質的重量相當於一座山。我們把它切成塊，然後整齊地堆疊起來。

record.singulo.r17.body.source: Energy will be drawn from the ergosphere of a spinning black hole. Theoretical efficiency: 42%. At last, all mass can become energy. The project is approved.
record.singulo.r17.body.translation: 能量將從旋轉黑洞的能層中獲得。理論效率：42%。最後，所有的質量都可以變成能量。該項目已獲批准。

record.singulo.r18.body.source: Tomorrow we ignite the seed. The horizon warden is in place. Should the core escape, the procedure is to seal the entire facility.
record.singulo.r18.body.translation: 明天我們點燃種子。地平線守望者已就位。如果核心逃逸，程式將密封整個設施。

record.singulo.r19.body.source: ...ignition successful. Output is... no, the spin will not stop... past the Eddington limit... stop the feed...
record.singulo.r19.body.translation: ....點火成功。輸出是...不，旋轉不會停止...超過愛丁頓極限...停止進給...

record.singulo.r20.body.source: We wanted to turn all mass into energy. The reactor granted that wish — the cities, the mountains, the sea. All that remains is the anomaly, the warden and this record. To whoever reads this: never let go of the hand that stops the feed.
record.singulo.r20.body.translation: 我們想將所有質量轉化為能量。反應爐實現了這個願望──城市、山脈、海洋。剩下的只有異常、典獄長和這份紀錄。對於讀到這篇文章的人：永遠不要放開停止餵食的手。
